notes.title: Improving Stealth Gameplay
notes.content:
We've listened to the feedback and made a lot of adjustments:

Various fixes to the AI, offering a smoother game experience.
- New, alternative cameras to give a wider view of the level, making the stealth gameplay a lot more enjoyable
- The first two volumes are receiving major stability and perfomance boosts (coming later to Vols 3 and 4)
- A lot of smaller bug fixes.

So now is the perfect time to jump in to the world of Thief of Thieves, and decided what kind of thief you will be!

notes.title: Volume 4 Available Now!
notes.content:
Volume 4 out now! 
Join Celia for the season finale of Thief of Thieves: Season One where we literally move up in the world. A new city, a new country, and the most complex heist to date. This is the time to apply all that you've learned and see if You too can rise to be a true Thief of Thieves.

New version is 1.2.0

notes.title: Volume 3 Available Now
notes.content:
Celia's adventures continue this week in the third installment of Thief of Thieves: Season One. Get ready for a heist that takes Celia and her team from balmy Turin to the icy heights of the Alps!

New version is 1.1.0

notes.title: Patch #1 out now!
notes.content:
We have just released the first patch. 

Version 1.0.1 includes following fixes:

- Improved off screen guard indicators
- General gameplay improvements
- Smaller bug fixes

Remember, Volume 3 will launch on Monday!

notes.title: Wot I Think Thief of Thieves: Season One
notes.content:
Thief of Thieves, an adaptation of a comic concept from the writer of The Walking Dead, boasts bags of style and the allure of stealthy heists twinned with a story that reacts to your decisions and failures.

It’s a hot mess.

notes.title: Heist adventure series Thief of Thieves begins today
notes.content:
Rival Games’s episodic sneak-thief comic adaptation Thief of Thieves has successfully infiltrated stores today, or at least the first volumes of this particular season has. It’s based on Robert Kirkman’s (The Walking Dead) comic of the same name, and our man Alec is currently casing the joint for a full review. Those feeling a little daring can take a peek for themselves at the launch trailer within.
